He is afebrile, slightly hypotensive and tachycardic, but stable. On examination, he has decreased skin turgor, and dry mucous membranes. He has no abdominal tenderness. Rectal examination is positive for gross blood.
pred_dx: Diverticular bleeding (lower gastrointestinal bleed from diverticulosis)
